description: The month's care report for one site, as CodeGene writes it for the owner: a headline, each program's checks, what was found, fixed and still open, what care spent and the notices sent. The month is a calendar month in time_zone (default UTC).

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone, such as America/Denver. Default UTC.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: get_care_report
title: Monthly care report
